mapper.insert: INSERT INTO problem (problem_name, problem_nick_name, case_amount, difficulty, tags, authors, create_time, update_time, content, freq, public, solution, show_solution) VALUES (#{problemName}, #{problemNickName}, #{caseAmount}, #{difficulty}, #{tags}, #{authors}, #{createtime}, #{updateTime}, #{content}, #{freq}, #{publicProblem}, #{solution}, #{showSolution})
mapper.update: UPDATE problem SET problem_nick_name = #{problemNickName}, case_amount = #{caseAmount}, difficulty = #{difficulty}, tags = #{tags}, authors = #{authors}, update_time = #{updateTime}, content = #{content}, freq = #{freq}, public = #{publicProblem}, solution = #{solution}, show_solution = #{showSolution} WHERE problem_name = #{problemName}
